notes.title: 🎉 We're Back with a BIG Update! 🎉
notes.content:
🎉 We're Back with a BIG Update! 🎉

Hello, artists and dreamers!

We’re thrilled to announce that MUSE is returning with a brand-new demo—now better than ever! 🎨✨

After listening to your feedback, we’ve polished gameplay, refined the art, and fine-tuned the story to make Clara’s journey even more immersive. And that’s not all! The demo now includes French, Japanese, and Chinese language support! 🌍

Stay tuned for the release date—and thank you for believing in MUSE. Let’s create something beautiful together. 💜[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513399/4ab57eaf7782055a68adbda1166d60af9d48d003.png[/img]

notes.title: THE MUSE DEMO IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513399/642f1e0f16e26d7a984449c612615c5f8b021436.png[/img]The wait is over! You can now play the Muse demo and experience a short but immersive journey into Clara’s mind as she battles artist’s block. 🖌️💭

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Your feedback is essential for the future of the game—your opinions and suggestions will help us make Muse even better. 💡💜

Download the demo, play, and let us know what you think! We can’t wait to hear from you. 🎭✨

notes.title: 🚨🎨 MUSE DEMO DROPS NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
🚨🎨 MUSE DEMO DROPS NEXT WEEK! 🎨🚨

It’s almost time! The prequel to Muse will be available next week, taking you on an emotional and surreal journey through Clara’s mind. 🖌️💭

Stay tuned for more details and get ready to explore this dreamlike world! ✨
